summary: All 15 backend regression tests pass (sync engine + master CRUD + user + logo + Excel round-trip). Frontend flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport: admin login, Master Data create+delete on segment tab, Import/Export screen buttons (export-data-button, download-template, choose-xlsx), Database Connection screen with queue-pending/queue-failed indicators and full table_sql (contains purchasing_sizes, segments, payment_terms, app_users, change_id). CREATE->DELETE-before-sync cancel verified, tombstone/no-reappear verified, master 404 for unknown type verified, dup master rename returns 409, Excel round-trip preview+commit reports create=1/update=1/skip>=46/error=1 with no duplicates and the new segment auto-created.

critical_code_review_comments: sync_engine.enqueue relies on _synced_ever(state.synced_ever) to decide whether to cancel a CREATE->DELETE — correct and idempotent.
excel_io round-trip is pure and covered end-to-end via /template.xlsx, /export.xlsx and /import/xlsx/{preview,commit}.
server.py POST /admin/users field is 'name' (not 'full_name'); frontend already sends 'name'.
server.py is 1908 lines — consider splitting (customers.py, admin_master.py, admin_users.py, supabase_sync.py, excel_routes.py) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: No seed changes. Tests create and clean up TEST_/UITest-prefixed rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Login response uses 'access_token' not 'token'. Admin user field is 'name'. Usernames are lowercased server-side. To inspect the sync queue use MongoDB directly: mongodb://localhost:27017 / test_database / sync_queue + sync_state. sync-toggle requires Supabase to be configured (returns 400 otherwise). Because Supabase is now configured AND schema is migrated in this env, the worker drains items quickly — tests assert 'queue item OR sync_state.synced_ever' for the freshly-created customer.
